plan.notes: Term-by-term sequence transcribed verbatim from the official ACTC 'Industrial Maintenance Technology Semester Plan' (ashland.kctcs.edu/education-training/semester-plans/industrial-maintenance-degree.aspx; Revised April 2026). Semester subtotals: 18+17+18+16 = 69. DISCREPANCY DOCUMENTED: the plan's semester subtotals sum to 69, which exceeds the page's stated 'Total Credits for Degree (Including General Education): 60-68' and its note 'A combination of general education and technical courses should not exceed 68 credit hours.' Per collection rules, items are transcribed verbatim and total_credits = the true sum (69); the discrepancy is flagged here for coordinator review. The five 'General Education Requirement' slots (3 credits each) correspond to the plan's General Education Component (Technical Mathematics or Higher; Natural Sciences; Social/Behavioral Sciences; Heritage/Humanities; Written Communication) — the page does not assign specific areas to specific semesters, so they are generic choice slots. Program notes preserved: 'Please refer to course catalog for complete listing of required Technical courses' / 'The student must have a plan of study on file in the academic affairs office.' / 'Credit earned through certificate and diploma program completion will be applicable toward the Associate of Applied Science when consistent with the objectives of the student's individual plan of study.' / 'To progress in the program a grade of "C" or better is required in each technical and mathematics course with maintenance of a 2.0 cumulative grade point average.' Course-level prereqs are not stated on the plan page and are therefore omitted. tccns mirrors the local course code (non-Texas school). transfer_confidence is 'core_only'.
